tasks.commitBody:
The season card now has a single header row in both states:
'Manage season' (static title, left), the season's delete as a red
trashcan (same control, same arm→confirm two-step), [+ Season],
then the gear alone on the right. The panel's own h2 header row is
gone — the card header is the panel's heading, so the phrase
renders exactly once; the panel's accessible name now points at the
visible label (aria-labelledby) and the orphaned
season_manage_panel_label key is removed from all four locales.

The delete being reachable while collapsed is deliberate (PO
ruling on the issue; two-step intact, same rights gate as the
gear). Two gaps closed per PO ruling on the issue: Escape from the
relocated controls routes through the existing
closeSeasonManagePanel() (one call clears armed state — no new
disarm branch), and the season-target error branch plus the
progress counter moved to card level so a collapsed-header cascade
shows its feedback — the series/events error branches keep their
per-list placement (#197 F5) and season-manage-delete-status is
untouched (#217 live-region contract).

The trashcan is a real toolbar member: roving arity is 3, with
explicit toolbarActiveTestid branches for the idle trashcan and the
armed confirm/cancel pair; the label stays a non-stop; the panel
stays outside the toolbar (#222 pin).

This is the #237 red-trashcan trial instance (Mihkel: 'lets try
red trashcan icon everywhere').

Live gate (Mihkel, phone §8.2): collapsed card shows label +
red trashcan + [+ Season] + gear; trashcan arm→confirm deletes with
visible progress; gear still opens/closes; header wrap on phone in
lv/uk.
